approval.approved_statement: The maintainer authorized the corrected DJConnect Platform 4.0 RC2 internal Pi rollout after RC1 installer validation exposed a resumable-install defect.
approval.effect: This approval authorizes only the immutable RC2 Pi candidate, the rbpi-djconnect Pi Zero 2W target, and its matching deployment and smoke workflows.

constraints: The candidate is an internal prerelease and must not be promoted to a stable release.
The deployment must resume safely after an interrupted installer run and verify the exact Pi Zero 2W ARM64 artifact checksum.
The Pi 5 wall appliance remains a separately targeted deployment and smoke operation.
next_authorized_action: Dispatch the Pi deployment workflow for rbpi-djconnect, then its matching post-deployment smoke workflow, using this exact binding.
